name: Sticker Peel
description: Draggable WebGL sticker made from any image. Its corner peels back on hover or press with a curled back side, a lit finish and a soft shadow, and it swings and bounces when dragged.
contents: Single WebGL2 canvas rendering the image as a curlable sticker mesh with shadow and lighting
Invisible hit area over the sticker for hover, press and drag
behavior: Sticker peels back partially on hover and further while pressed
Drag moves the sticker with swing, friction and bounce, confined to the parent box
Light highlight follows the pointer when followPointer is on
Intro animation fades and settles the sticker in, skipped with reduced motion
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden
Touch pointers clear hover state on release
editableByProps: Sticker image, width, rotation and peel direction
Peel amounts, curl radius, back color and finish (gloss, matte, holo)
Lighting, shadow, pointer-follow, drag, swing, friction, bounce
Intro on or off, start offset, drag callbacks, pixel ratio

needsCodeEdit.change: Change transparent padding around the image or texture resolution

needsCodeEdit.where: FINISHES constant and the FRAGMENT shader
dt / 1.1 expression in the frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable
Positioned absolute at the top left of its parent, so the parent must be a positioned container with a size; the sticker is confined to that box
Image is loaded with crossOrigin anonymous, so remote images need CORS headers
Listens to window pointermove for the light and uses ResizeObserver and IntersectionObserver, all cleaned up on unmount
Texture is capped at 1024px and pixel ratio at 2
Parent must be sized on small screens; hit area follows the width prop, so a large width can fill a phone-sized parent
